style: 3D cartoon, Pixar, dry deadpan satire, vertical 9:16 frame, taller than wide
motion_rule: she rides a rolling market cart that never stops, the stalls flying past her every beat, the cart swerving and reversing at 0.35, 0.90, 1.90, 3.20, 4.40 and 6.60; the camera tracks sideways alongside it, new shot size each beat, ONE sideways move per beat; her muzzle never under a third of frame, jaw visible; she stays on the cart all clip, never on her feet at the lens
character: a wiry macaque in a grey waistcoat riding a rolling market cart, exactly two arms, muzzle and jaw clear
second_characters: A SWARM of creditors in grey suits running alongside the cart, ONE of them a shoulder from the lens every beat, crossing frame and hitting the glass; all of them moving
props: ONE carrying pole across her shoulders; ONE sack of pale jute roped to each end, same cloth and size, the left stencilled ДОЛГИ, the right ИПОТЕКА, one big black Cyrillic word each; A SWARM of paper slips inside the sacks
prop_continuity: the pole rides on her shoulders all clip, both sacks stay roped to its ends
environment: a market street packed wall to wall, stalls, crates and awnings a shoulder from the lens, paper and torn leaves across the glass
light_events: white noon, shafts between the awnings sweeping her every beat, a hard rim on her muzzle

audio.delivery: a level pleased female voice, biting off each word, even 3.9 syllables per second, beats filled edge to edge
audio.pronunciation: pro-ve-RYA-em, SLE-va, dol-GI, SPRA-va, i-po-TE-ka, ba-LANS, so-SHOL-sya, PRO-sto, o-BE-ikh, sto-RON
audio.pacing: speech runs unbroken 0.00 to 7.20, first word at 0.00, no gap between beats; after 7.20 wheels, boots and paper fill the track to 10.00
audio.lip_sync: her jaw opens on every syllable, no voice over
audio.sfx: cart wheels on stone, the roar of the street, boots, paper

timeline.a: the cart is already rolling in the very first frame, stalls streaming past her, a creditor crossing a shoulder from the lens onto the glass
her left shoulder drives the left sack across frame to the lens, its word to the glass, the cart swerving under her
her right shoulder drives the right sack to the lens the same way, its word to the glass, and she shoves a running creditor off the rail
the cart drops off a kerb at the lens, both sacks carried forward level with each other
she yanks the left rope mid-roll, a jet of slips into the face of the creditor at the rail
she yanks the right rope mid-roll, the same jet of slips into the same face
the cart clips a crate and slews sideways, the pole and both sacks sweeping the frame
the creditors haul the cart across frame by its rail, her muzzle filling the glass
the cart rides at the lens through the paper, her muzzle into the glass, jaw open, both sacks thrown forward

must_appear: the cart already rolling in frame one; ДОЛГИ on the left sack, ИПОТЕКА on the right, both readable at 3.20; the left sack opened at 4.40 and the right at 6.60 by the same yank, the same slips out of both; nothing touches her before 7.20; every word spoken, the last by 7.20; jaw open on every syllable
negative_prompt: subtitles, watermark, letterbox, horizontal frame, a static camera, a still background, a still first frame, a held pose, a parked cart, a tree branch under her, a hero sitting in place, a hero running at the camera on her feet, a wide or distant hero, standing bystanders, an empty street, slow motion, digits, a word not in the lines, a closed jaw while speaking, hands grabbing or carrying the hero before 7.20, extra limbs, multiple monkeys, foreign accent
